title: Universal property of the finite Tate line
statement: Fix a scheme T, a prime ell, a commutative ring B and a unital map a from Z/ell^(n+1) to B. The finite Tate line [def-pur-finite-tate-line-signed-comparison] represents additive morphisms from the actual ell^(n+1)-roots sheaf [def-sp-tower-class-systems] to the underlying additive sheaf of an arbitrary B_T-module N. The Hom equivalences are natural for postcomposition. If q is the additive root morphism corresponding to f, then b times q(z) equals f of the specified finite pure tensor b tensor z.

proof.text: For any two module sheaves over the constant ZMod(k) ring sheaf, normalize each scalar action on integer sections by map_intCast and Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul. Module restriction maps supply semilinearity, and constantZModModuleSheaf_nsmul supplies annihilation. Apply torsionSheaf_hom_linear to make every additive sheaf morphism linear. Transport this through purTwistFiniteRingIso by restricting both modules along its inverse; its hom_inv_id recovers the original actions. PresheafOfModules.homMk and forgetting now give inverse Hom equivalences. The underlying additive sheaf of purTwistRootsModule is definitionally the actual root sheaf, and restricting the target scalars preserves its underlying sheaf. Compose this forgetful equivalence with the tensor Hom equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteTateLine_universal (T : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B] (n : ℕ) (a : ZMod (l ^ (n + 1)) →+* B) :
    ∃ Ψ : ∀ N : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
            (Scheme.tateFiniteCoefficient T B)),
      (Scheme.tateFiniteLine T l B n a ⟶ N) ≃
        ((roots l T).obj (op n) ⟶ (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj N),
      (∀ {N N'} (f : Scheme.tateFiniteLine T l B n a ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ N'),
        Ψ N' (f ≫ g) = Ψ N f ≫ (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map g) ∧
      (∀ N (f : Scheme.tateFiniteLine T l B n a ⟶ N) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (b : (Scheme.tateFiniteCoefficient T B).obj.obj U)
        (z : ((roots l T).obj (op n)).obj.obj U),
        b • (show N.val.obj U from (Ψ N f).hom.app U z) =
          f.val.app U (Scheme.tateFiniteTensor T l B n a U.unop b z))

tool_uses.why: Generic full faithfulness of forgetting constant residue-ring module structure identifies the tensor-adjunction Hom set with additive root-sheaf morphisms.
